title: Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing: Certificate Types and Ordering States Served
content:
The Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing is issued as one of six certificates. Each certificate is filed on a set form, certifies a set scope of driving, and can be filed only with the ordering states listed against it. The filing always goes to the ordering state, that is, the state whose order requires the driver to show proof of financial responsibility.

## Certificate schedule

| Certificate | Form filed with the state | What the certificate certifies | Certifies driving of vehicles not on the policy | Names the scheduled vehicles by VIN | Ordering states to which it can be filed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal SR-22 Owner Certificate | SR-22 | Owner: the vehicles the driver owns that are scheduled on the policy | No | Yes | OH, IN, KY, VA, WV |
| Cardinal SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | SR-22 | Owner-operator: the owned, scheduled vehicles plus any vehicle not on the policy that the driver operates | Yes | No | OH, IN, KY, VA, WV |
| Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner Certificate | SR-22 | Owner | No | Yes | TN, MI, IL, MO |
| Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | SR-22 | Owner-operator | Yes | No | TN, MI, IL, MO |
| Cardinal FR-44 Owner Certificate | FR-44 | Owner | No | Yes | VA |
| Cardinal FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate | FR-44 | Owner-operator | Yes | No | VA |

State receiving the filing, every certificate: the ordering state.

## Reading the schedule

- **Owner and owner-operator scope.** An owner certificate certifies only the owned vehicles scheduled on the policy and names them by VIN. An owner-operator certificate also certifies the driver's operation of vehicles that are not on the policy, and it does not name vehicles.
- **Form.** The four SR-22 certificates are filed on the SR-22 form; the two FR-44 certificates are filed on the FR-44 form.
- **States.** The in-state SR-22 certificates serve Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky, Virginia and West Virginia; the out-of-state SR-22 certificates serve Tennessee, Michigan, Illinois and Missouri; the FR-44 certificates serve Virginia only.

## Points of reference

**Which state is the certificate sent to?** The ordering state on the order, on every certificate type.

**Does an owner-operator certificate list the household's cars?** No. Listing vehicles by VIN is a feature of the three owner certificates only.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A certificate on the Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner Certificate answering an Illinois order is filed with Illinois, on the SR-22 form, and names the scheduled vehicles by VIN. The state and certificate in this illustration are chosen for the example only.
